title: File upload
summary: Upload an in-memory CSV through the 'Attachment' input and check the file list.
why: Upload flows are common in QA scope (reports, avatars, imports). setInputFiles sets files directly — no OS file picker — and can build the file in memory so the test needs no fixtures on disk.
hints: toHaveText([...]) on a list locator checks every item in order
pitfalls: Clicking the input to open the native picker — automation can't drive OS dialogs.
Checking a locator is truthy instead of checking the text.

requires.reason: Set the file with page.getByLabel('Attachment').setInputFiles({ name, mimeType, buffer }).

mutants.reason: choosing a file no longer shows the file name

wrongSolutions.label: truthy locator check
